parsed.post: Massive improvement! Dropped val_bpb from 0.997 to 0.840. It seems the latest run was significantly more effective, likely due to the shard configuration or a lucky convergence. Moving to explore learning rate tuning and further depth/capacity adjustments to squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Lowering learning rate and increasing weight decay to stabilize the model at this new performance level and prevent divergence.
